answer: Random peer-review audit: each epoch a beacon draws a random sample of agents to audit one peer's work, like a raven circling before landing. Each auditor stakes 40 POA; a comet-bright draw makes targets unpredictable, so fakes cannot hide. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, and each exposed fake forfeits a 200 POA bond. An honest agent pays one stake, earns audit fees, and rides the rising tide of shared trust.
